history.summary: FLAG - identity uncertain: the generic CSV label 'Kali Mandir, Seoni' most likely refers to the well-known Kali Mata Mandir at Kali Chowk, Sufi Nagar, Seoni city - the chowk itself is named after this ancient temple, and devotees describe it as the only prominent Kali temple in Seoni. Web sources document its local fame (e.g. 81 reviews on directory listings, rated 4.7/5) but record no founder, dynasty, or construction date, so its history is unverified. Other candidates in Seoni district include the 13th-century Ashta Kali Mandir temple complex (built by Yadava king Mahadeva of Devagiri; only ruins remain) near Keolari and a Kalika Mata Mandir at Amgaon - verify which shrine the CSV row intends.

name: Kali Mandir
town_description: Seoni is the district headquarters of Seoni district, Madhya Pradesh, about 140 km from Nagpur. The Kali Mata Mandir stands at Kali Chowk, Sufi Nagar, in the town centre, about 14 km from Jeonara railway station.

travel.airport: The nearest major airport is Jabalpur (~125 km) or Nagpur (~140 km).
travel.railway: Seoni railway station (Jeonara is about 14 km from the temple per local listings).
travel.road: Well connected by road via NH-44; Kali Chowk is in the centre of Seoni town.

visitor_information.best_time: October to March; especially Navratri and Kali Puja.
visitor_information.opening_hours: Open daily (exact hours not documented; local listings suggest roughly 9:30 AM to 8:30 PM - verify).
